title: Warranty Coverage Lead-Safe Work Practice Allowance on Labor
content:
**Note.** When the installation job of the covered openings carried a lead-safe fee, the home was worked under lead-safe practices, and labor on a Warranty Coverage technician visit adds a lead-safe allowance in hours:

- a visit on a **frame and sash, exterior finish or installation workmanship** claim adds the full lead-safe allowance of **1.0 hour**;
- a visit on a claim for **any other component** adds the glass and hardware lead-safe allowance of **0.5 hour**;
- a visit to openings whose job carried no lead-safe fee adds no allowance.

## Both conditions together

| Lead-safe fee on the installation job | Component of the claim | Allowance |
|---|---|---|
| yes | frame and sash | 1.0 hour |
| yes | exterior finish | 1.0 hour |
| yes | installation workmanship | 1.0 hour |
| yes | insulated glass, hardware, screen, weatherstrip or any other component | 0.5 hour |
| no | any component | none |

## Where it is read

- The lead-safe fee is a fee booked on the installation job in the Installation Jobs records; the job is the one recorded on the Warranty Coverage registration, whose completion started coverage.
- The component is the one the claim names.
